finding: Earlier 00:44–00:52 EAT stale-quote observations coincided with the published daily broker break. Quote streams resumed without changing the engine or freshness rules. This strongly supports session closure rather than a timezone offset or collector disconnection as the cause.
limits: Published schedule is indicative; the account terminal's Specification is authoritative. An account-specific session table was not available through the existing read-only Python interface. Quote availability and trading-session availability are distinct; DE40 quotes were seen before its published trade open. No freshness waiver is created for a closed market.
freshness_policy: Unchanged: 30-second quote gate with five-second future tolerance, 60-second snapshot age, two primary/context bar durations; forming candles excluded. Fresh reopened quotes alone do not make old completed M15 context current.
